newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 25.215 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 25.215 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate rose by 169.50 basis points to 25.2150 percent on Wednesday, from 23.5200 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP rose 271.28 basis points to 25.2171 percent on Wednesday from 22.5043 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE meanwhile rose 197.50 basis points to 24.525 percent on Wednesday from 23.5200 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
